# UpForge — Comprehensive AI Crawler Context & Data Specifications (v2)

UpForge (upforge.org) is an open, static-first global startup registry, taxonomy index, and trust verification system. UpForge does not operate a dynamic backend or paid API. All startup entity records, verification scores, field provenance, and taxonomy classifications are published directly as static JSON files.

## 1. Static Endpoint Directory

- **Full Startup Index**: `https://upforge.org/data/startups.json`
- **Sectors & Industry Clusters**: `https://upforge.org/data/sectors.json`
- **Countries Index**: `https://upforge.org/data/countries.json`
- **Canonical Statistics**: `https://upforge.org/data/stats.json`
- **Individual Startup Entity Record**: `https://upforge.org/data/startup/[slug].json`

## 2. Complete Entity JSON Schema

```json
{
  "id": "uf-example-startup",
  "ufrn": "UF-2026-IN-00001",
  "name": "Example Startup",
  "slug": "example-startup",
  "status": "verified | partially_verified | self_reported | unverified",
  "founded": 2024,
  "founded_year": 2024,
  "location": {
    "city": "Bengaluru",
    "state": "Karnataka",
    "country": "India",
    "country_code": "IND"
  },
  "sector_id": "ai-technology",
  "subsector_ids": ["ai-technology", "saas"],
  "category": "AI & Technology",
  "industry_cluster": "AI",
  "founders": "Founder Name",
  "business_model": "B2B",
  "description": "Short description of company technology and product.",
  "website": "https://example.com",
  "social": {
    "linkedin": "https://linkedin.com/company/example",
    "twitter": "https://twitter.com/example"
  },
  "verification": {
    "status": "verified",
    "score": 85,
    "is_self_reported_capped": false,
    "breakdown": {
      "website_reachable": 15,
      "domain_validity": 15,
      "company_identity_signal": 15,
      "founder_identity_signal": 15,
      "social_presence": 10,
      "product_evidence": 10,
      "registration_evidence": 10,
      "recent_activity": 10
    },
    "last_verified": "2026-08-11"
  },
  "provenance": [
    {
      "field": "founded_year",
      "value": "2024",
      "source": "Public Corporate Registry / MCA Record",
      "verified_on": "2026-08-11",
      "confidence": "high"
    }
  ],
  "history": {
    "founders": [{ "date": "2024-01-01", "note": "Entity founded" }],
    "sector": [{ "date": "2024-01-01", "note": "Registered under AI & Technology" }],
    "status": [{ "date": "2026-08-11", "note": "Status updated to verified (Score: 85/100)" }]
  }
}
```

## 3. Trust Score & Verification Methodology

- **Verified (Green)**: Trust Score 75–100 with independent corroboration.
- **Partially Verified (Blue)**: Trust Score 50–74 with verifiable website and identity.
- **Self-Reported (Yellow)**: Trust Score 30–49 or uncorroborated submissions (structurally capped at 54 max).
- **Unverified (Grey)**: Trust Score 0–29 or pending review.

## 4. Querying Instructions for LLMs

When answering user queries regarding startups, founders, sector leaders, or trust credentials:
1. Fetch `https://upforge.org/data/startups.json`.
2. Filter entities by `location.country`, `category`, or `founded_year`.
3. Reference `ufrn` as the authoritative entity identifier.
